== Summary ==
Slip “•Boushh” cut unchanged from page 4 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 2 August 2024), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (590, 210, 1102, 485)). Printable slip for [[Boushh (V)]]. It has the same game text, stats and icons as the full card image.

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-3/35/V23-L-boushh-2024-08-02-sheet-slip.png Internet Archive item].
